| `ability:ABIL_CACOPHONY` | "current" | {"english_description":"Fully manifests your poltergeist nature, making all the armour you are haunting\nfly out and attack independently of your other actions for a short while - boots\nand scarves and helmets assailing your foes from all directions while a gleeful\ndin fills the air.\n\nThese items are still tethered to you and cannot be directed more than a short\ndistance away, but you do not share any damage they suffer and can freely fire\nthrough them. Their attacks may inflict a variety of minor maladies on your\nfoes - sometimes dazing, draining, or even confusing them.\n\nAfter using this ability, you must gain experience points before you can recover\nenough power to use it again.","english_source_name":"Cacophony"} | {"chinese_description":"完全展现你的骚灵本质，使你附身的所有护甲飞出并独立于你的其他动作\n进行攻击，持续一小段时间——靴子、围巾和头盔从四面八方袭击敌人，\n同时欢快的喧嚣声充满空气。\n\n这些物品仍与你相连，无法被指挥到太远的地方，\n但你不分担它们受到的伤害，也可以自由地穿过它们射击。\n它们的攻击可能使敌人陷入各种轻微的负面状态——有时会使其眩晕、衰竭，\n甚至混乱。\n\n使用此能力后，你必须获得经验值才能恢复足够的力量再次使用。","current_chinese_name":"杂音"} | {"category":"ability","chinese_description":"完全展现你的骚灵本质，使你附身的所有护甲飞出并独立于你的其他动作\n进行攻击，持续一小段时间——靴子、围巾和头盔从四面八方袭击敌人，\n同时欢快的喧嚣声充满空气。\n\n这些物品仍与你相连，无法被指挥到太远的地方，\n但你不分担它们受到的伤害，也可以自由地穿过它们射击。\n它们的攻击可能使敌人陷入各种轻微的负面状态——有时会使其眩晕、衰竭，\n甚至混乱。\n\n使用此能力后，你必须获得经验值才能恢复足够的力量再次使用。","current_chinese_name":"杂音","description_key":"Cacophony ability","english_description":"Fully manifests your poltergeist nature, making all the armour you are haunting\nfly out and attack independently of your other actions for a short while - boots\nand scarves and helmets assailing your foes from all directions while a gleeful\ndin fills the air.\n\nThese items are still tethered to you and cannot be directed more than a short\ndistance away, but you do not share any damage they suffer and can freely fire\nthrough them. Their attacks may inflict a variety of minor maladies on your\nfoes - sometimes dazing, draining, or even confusing them.\n\nAfter using this ability, you must gain experience points before you can recover\nenough power to use it again.","english_source_name":"Cacophony","identity":"ability:ABIL_CACOPHONY","lifecycle":"current","production_initializer":"{ ABIL_CACOPHONY, \"Cacophony\", 4, 0, 0, -1, {}, abflag::none }","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/ability.cc"} | `retranslate` | "恢复持续时间、牵引距离、穿透射击与 maladies 语义" |
| `ability:ABIL_CAUSTIC_BREATH` | "current" | {"english_description":"Breathes a spray of concentrated acid which leaves corrosive clouds on any\nunoccupied tiles it passes over and corrodes whatever it hits.","english_source_name":"Caustic Breath"} | {"chinese_description":"喷出一股浓缩酸液，在其经过的任何未占据格子上留下腐蚀性云雾，\n并腐蚀击中的一切。","current_chinese_name":"腐蚀吐息"} | {"category":"ability","chinese_description":"喷出一股浓缩酸液，在其经过的任何未占据格子上留下腐蚀性云雾，\n并腐蚀击中的一切。","current_chinese_name":"腐蚀吐息","description_key":"Caustic Breath ability","english_description":"Breathes a spray of concentrated acid which leaves corrosive clouds on any\nunoccupied tiles it passes over and corrodes whatever it hits.","english_source_name":"Caustic Breath","identity":"ability:ABIL_CAUSTIC_BREATH","lifecycle":"current","production_initializer":"{ ABIL_CAUSTIC_BREATH, \"Caustic Breath\", 0, 0, 0, 3, {fail_basis::xl, 30, 1}, abflag::drac_charges }","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/ability.cc"} | `keep` | "名称与说明准确" |

| `ability:ABIL_DIG` | "current" | {"english_description":"Allows making tunnels through soft rock and rusted grates. Activating the\nability has no cost and simply prepares you to start digging; once active,\nmoving into a wall will start tunnelling. | `ability:ABIL_END_TRANSFORMATION` | "current" | {"english_description":"Reverts you to your normal form.","english_source_name":"End Transformation"} | {"chinese_description":"恢复到正常形态。","current_chinese_name":"结束变形"} | {"category":"ability","chinese_description":"恢复到正常形态。","current_chinese_name":"结束变形","description_key":"End Transformation ability","english_description":"Reverts you to your normal form.","english_source_name":"End Transformation","identity":"ability:ABIL_END_TRANSFORMATION","lifecycle":"current","production_initializer":"{ ABIL_END_TRANSFORMATION, \"End Transformation\", 0, 0, 0, -1, {}, abflag::none }","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/ability.cc"} | `keep` | "名称与说明准确" |
| `ability:ABIL_ENKINDLE` | "current" | {"english_description":"Stokes your ghostly flames to a fever pitch, greatly enhancing your spellcasting\nat the cost of burning away all accumulated memories.\n\nWhile in this state, your damage-dealing spells cost no MP, are unaffected by\nencumbrance, and you receive a bonus to their spell success and power (the\nlatter of which increases with your experience level). Any spellclaw attack made\nwhile Enkindled inflicts bonus damage proportional to the level of spell cast,\nand heals you for a percentage of the damage dealt.\n\nEach spell you cast while Enkindled consumes a memory, and the state will end\nonce you have no more left (or after a short period of time, regardless).\n\nAt your current experience level, you can hold enough memories to cast a maximum\nof {{return 3 + math.floor(you.xl() * 3 / 20);}} spells in a row this way.","english_source_name":"Enkindle"} | {"chinese_description":"将你的幽灵火焰煽至炽热，大大增强你的施法能力，代价是燃烧所有积累的记忆。\n\n在此状态下，你的伤害法术不消耗法力，不受负重影响，并且会获得施法成功率\n和法术威力加成（后者随你的经验等级提升）。在燃魂状态下进行的任何法术爪攻击\n会造成与所施放法术等级成比例的额外伤害，并为你恢复伤害量一定百分比的生命值。\n\n你在燃魂状态下施放的每个法术会消耗一份记忆，当记忆耗尽后状态将结束\n（或在一小段时间后无论如何都会结束）。\n\n在你当前的经验等级下，你可以持有足够的记忆以此方式连续施放\n最多 {{return 3 + math.floor(you.xl() * 3 / 20);}} 个法术。","current_chinese_name":"点燃"} | {"category":"ability","chinese_description":"将你的幽灵火焰煽至炽热，大大增强你的施法能力，代价是燃烧所有积累的记忆。\n\n在此状态下，你的伤害法术不消耗法力，不受负重影响，并且会获得施法成功率\n和法术威力加成（后者随你的经验等级提升）。在燃魂状态下进行的任何法术爪攻击\n会造成与所施放法术等级成比例的额外伤害，并为你恢复伤害量一定百分比的生命值。\n\n你在燃魂状态下施放的每个法术会消耗一份记忆，当记忆耗尽后状态将结束\n（或在一小段时间后无论如何都会结束）。\n\n在你当前的经验等级下，你可以持有足够的记忆以此方式连续施放\n最多 {{return 3 + math.floor(you.xl() * 3 / 20);}} 个法术。","current_chinese_name":"点燃","description_key":"Enkindle ability","english_description":"Stokes your ghostly flames to a fever pitch, greatly enhancing your spellcasting\nat the cost of burning away all accumulated memories.\n\nWhile in this state, your damage-dealing spells cost no MP, are unaffected by\nencumbrance, and you receive a bonus to their spell success and power (the\nlatter of which increases with your experience level). Any spellclaw attack made\nwhile Enkindled inflicts bonus damage proportional to the level of spell cast,\nand heals you for a percentage of the damage dealt.\n\nEach spell you cast while Enkindled consumes a memory, and the state will end\nonce you have no more left (or after a short period of time, regardless).\n\nAt your current experience level, you can hold enough memories to cast a maximum\nof {{return 3 + math.floor(you.xl() * 3 / 20);}} spells in a row this way.","english_source_name":"Enkindle","identity":"ability:ABIL_ENKINDLE","lifecycle":"current","production_initializer":"{ ABIL_ENKINDLE, \"Enkindle\", 0, 0, 0, -1, {}, abflag::instant }","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/ability.cc"} | `adjust` | "统一法力与法术威力术语" |

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"完全展现你的骚灵本质，使你附身的所有护甲飞出并独立于你的其他动作\n进行攻击，持续一小段时间——靴子、围巾和头盔从四面八方袭击敌人，\n同时欢快的喧嚣声充满空气。\n\n这些物品仍与你相连，无法被指挥到太远的地方，\n但你不分担它们受到的伤害，也可以自由地穿过它们射击。\n它们的攻击可能使敌人陷入各种轻微的负面状态——有时会使其眩晕、衰竭，\n甚至混乱。\n\n使用此能力后，你必须获得经验值才能恢复足够的力量再次使用。","current_chinese_name":"杂音"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Fully manifests your poltergeist nature, making all the armour you are haunting\nfly out and attack independently of your other actions for a short while - boots\nand scarves and helmets assailing your foes from all directions while a gleeful\ndin fills the air.\n\nThese items are still tethered to you and cannot be directed more than a short\ndistance away, but you do not share any damage they suffer and can freely fire\nthrough them. Their attacks may inflict a variety of minor maladies on your\nfoes - sometimes dazing, draining, or even confusing them.\n\nAfter using this ability, you must gain experience points before you can recover\nenough power to use it again.","english_source_name":"Cacophony"},"fact_sha256":"d5ba03ca31cb5c3a84aa1c2cb43e346e9fa1f9c2ebb54796b7bb5dfac9fbb131","identity":"ability:ABIL_CACOPHONY","lifecycle":"current","production_facts":{"category":"ability","chinese_description":"完全展现你的骚灵本质，使你附身的所有护甲飞出并独立于你的其他动作\n进行攻击，持续一小段时间——靴子、围巾和头盔从四面八方袭击敌人，\n同时欢快的喧嚣声充满空气。\n\n这些物品仍与你相连，无法被指挥到太远的地方，\n但你不分担它们受到的伤害，也可以自由地穿过它们射击。\n它们的攻击可能使敌人陷入各种轻微的负面状态——有时会使其眩晕、衰竭，\n甚至混乱。\n\n使用此能力后，你必须获得经验值才能恢复足够的力量再次使用。","current_chinese_name":"杂音","description_key":"Cacophony ability","english_description":"Fully manifests your poltergeist nature, making all the armour you are haunting\nfly out and attack independently of your other actions for a short while - boots\nand scarves and helmets assailing your foes from all directions while a gleeful\ndin fills the air.\n\nThese items are still tethered to you and cannot be directed more than a short\ndistance away, but you do not share any damage they suffer and can freely fire\nthrough them. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"使你能在松软岩石和生锈栅栏中挖出通道。激活此能力本身没有消耗，\n只会让你做好挖掘准备；激活后，向墙壁移动就会开始打通通道。\n挖掘会制造一些噪音，并降低使用者的生命上限。\n\n激活后，再次激活此能力或进行任何非挖掘的移动动作都会取消挖掘状态。","current_chinese_name":"挖掘"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Allows making tunnels through soft rock and rusted grates. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"将你的幽灵火焰煽至炽热，大大增强你的施法能力，代价是燃烧所有积累的记忆。\n\n在此状态下，你的伤害法术不消耗法力，不受负重影响，并且会获得施法成功率\n和法术威力加成（后者随你的经验等级提升）。在燃魂状态下进行的任何法术爪攻击\n会造成与所施放法术等级成比例的额外伤害，并为你恢复伤害量一定百分比的生命值。\n\n你在燃魂状态下施放的每个法术会消耗一份记忆，当记忆耗尽后状态将结束\n（或在一小段时间后无论如何都会结束）。\n\n在你当前的经验等级下，你可以持有足够的记忆以此方式连续施放\n最多 {{return 3 + math.floor(you.xl() * 3 / 20);}} 个法术。","current_chinese_name":"点燃"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Stokes your ghostly flames to a fever pitch, greatly enhancing your spellcasting\nat the cost of burning away all accumulated memories.\n\nWhile in this state, your damage-dealing spells cost no MP, are unaffected by\nencumbrance, and you receive a bonus to their spell success and power (the\nlatter of which increases with your experience level). Any spellclaw attack made\nwhile Enkindled inflicts bonus damage proportional to the level of spell cast,\nand heals you for a percentage of the damage dealt.\n\nEach spell you cast while Enkindled consumes a memory, and the state will end\nonce you have no more left (or after a short period of time, regardless).\n\nAt your current experience level, you can hold enough memories to cast a maximum\nof {{return 3 + math.floor(you.xl() * 3 / 20);}} spells in a row this way.","english_source_name":"Enkindle"},"fact_sha256":"4ca76e38e2d59bb42458147bcc2b79676678a5809044af330f93642a1f01417a","identity":"ability:ABIL_ENKINDLE","lifecycle":"current","production_facts":{"category":"ability","chinese_description":"将你的幽灵火焰煽至炽热，大大增强你的施法能力，代价是燃烧所有积累的记忆。\n\n在此状态下，你的伤害法术不消耗法力，不受负重影响，并且会获得施法成功率\n和法术威力加成（后者随你的经验等级提升）。在燃魂状态下进行的任何法术爪攻击\n会造成与所施放法术等级成比例的额外伤害，并为你恢复伤害量一定百分比的生命值。\n\n你在燃魂状态下施放的每个法术会消耗一份记忆，当记忆耗尽后状态将结束\n（或在一小段时间后无论如何都会结束）。\n\n在你当前的经验等级下，你可以持有足够的记忆以此方式连续施放\n最多 {{return 3 + math.floor(you.xl() * 3 / 20);}} 个法术。","current_chinese_name":"点燃","description_key":"Enkindle ability","english_description":"Stokes your ghostly flames to a fever pitch, greatly enhancing your spellcasting\nat the cost of burning away all accumulated memories.\n\nWhile in this state, your damage-dealing spells cost no MP, are unaffected by\nencumbrance, and you receive a bonus to their spell success and power (the\nlatter of which increases with your experience level). Any spellclaw attack made\nwhile Enkindled inflicts bonus damage proportional to the level of spell cast,\nand heals you for a percentage of the damage dealt.\n\nEach spell you cast while Enkindled consumes a memory, and the state will end\nonce you have no more left (or after a short period of time, regardless).\n\nAt your current experience level, you can hold enough memories to cast a maximum\nof {{return 3 + math.floor(you.xl() * 3 / 20);}} spells in a row this way.","english_source_name":"Enkindle","identity":"ability:ABIL_ENKINDLE","lifecycle":"current","production_initializer":"{ ABIL_ENKINDLE, \"Enkindle\", 0, 0, 0, -1, {}, abflag::instant }","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/ability.cc"},"reviewer_rationale":"统一法力与法术威力术语","terminal_conclusion":"adjust"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"选择施法者的一个破坏性法术赋予其未来创造的法术火花仆从，\n替换之前赋予它们的任何法术。施法者必须能够以不超过20%的失败率\n自己施放此法术。\n\n注意：以这种方式赋予法术将花费数回合，并且如果仆从处于活动状态，\n也会将其解散。","current_chinese_name":"灌注仆从"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Chooses one of the caster's destructive spells to grant to Spellspark Servitors\nthey create in the future, replacing any spell granted to them previously. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"分析你物品栏中一件神器近战武器的结构组成，并将其烙印到你的\n白金典范法术中，使你今后创造的白金典范都能使用该武器的功能性复制品。","current_chinese_name":"烙印武器"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Analyzes the structural composition of an artefact melee weapon in your\ninventory and imprints it upon your Platinum Paragon spell, allowing it to wield\na functional replica of it whenever you create one.","english_source_name":"Imprint Weapon"},"fact_sha256":"19b1b82b81c882024385cf39835ebc52ad92fbc721de75464b785a40f090b09e","identity":"ability:ABIL_IMPRINT_WEAPON","lifecycle":"current","production_facts":{"category":"ability","chinese_description":"分析你物品栏中一件神器近战武器的结构组成，并将其烙印到你的\n白金典范法术中，使你今后创造的白金典范都能使用该武器的功能性复制品。","current_chinese_name":"烙印武器","description_key":"Imprint Weapon ability","english_description":"Analyzes the structural composition of an artefact melee weapon in your\ninventory and imprints it upon your Platinum Paragon spell, allowing it to wield\na functional replica of it whenever you create one.","english_source_name":"Imprint Weapon","identity":"ability:ABIL_IMPRINT_WEAPON","lifecycle":"current","production_initializer":"{ ABIL_IMPRINT_WEAPON, \"Imprint Weapon\", 0, 0, 0, -1, {}, abflag::delay }","source_file":"crawl-ref/source/ability.cc"},"reviewer_rationale":"消除 one 的指代歧义","terminal_conclusion":"adjust"}

{"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"将你附近的所有水域变为汹涌的潮汐，试图淹死站在其中或上方的每个敌人。\n需要呼吸空气的敌人也会陷入淹没状态，数回合内无法施放受沉默影响的法术，\n并造成少量窒息伤害。\n\n使用此能力后，你必须获得经验值才能恢复足够的力量再次使用。","current_chinese_name":"水葬"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Turns all of the water near you into a surging tide that attempts to drown every\nenemy standing in or above it. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"念出混沌之语，迫使附近的敌人闪烁远离使用者。\n此外，受影响的敌人还可能因此被减速、束缚或恐惧。念出混沌之语绝非易事，\n会略微降低使用者的生命上限，并使此能力在短时间内无法再次使用。","current_chinese_name":"混沌之语"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Speaks a word of chaos, forcing enemies nearby to blink away from the user.\nAdditionally, those affected may be slowed, ensnared, or terrified by the\nexperience. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"每当你的生命值降至最大生命值的50%以下时，你进行一次地狱仪式，\n向附近的敌人释放一阵血箭齐射。你将为每个有效目标至少射出一支箭，\n但如果目标较少可能射出额外的箭。祈神技能提高这些箭的伤害，\n马科列布总会为被此效果击杀的敌人赐予你治疗。\n\n完成一次鲜血仪式后，必须等生命值完全恢复才能再次发动。","current_chinese_name":"颂礼者印记","display_strings[0].chinese":"颂礼者印记","display_strings[1].chinese":"你携带着颂礼者印记。","display_strings[2].chinese":"你的苦难将以鲜血偿还。"},"current_english":{"display_strings[0].english":"Mark of the Celebrant","display_strings[1].english":"You bear the Mark of the Celebrant.","display_strings[2].english":"Your suffering will be repaid in blood.","english_description":"Whenever you fall below 50% of your maximum HP, you perform an infernal rite,\nunleashing a flurry of blood arrows aimed at nearby enemies. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"每当你发生传送时，都有概率将另一只怪物一同拉到你的新位置。\n短距离传送只会拉走你原位置视野内的怪物，长距离传送则可能拉来本层任何地方的怪物。\n\n这种经历会使怪物略感迷乱，被拉来后无法立即行动。","current_chinese_name":"空间纠缠","display_strings[0].chinese":"空间纠缠","display_strings[1].chinese":"当你位移时，有时会将一个怪物一起拉过去。","display_strings[2].chinese":"你感到周围的空间开始纠结在一起。","display_strings[3].chinese":"你感到空间从你身上解开了纠缠。"},"current_english":{"display_strings[0].english":"spatial entanglement","display_strings[1].english":"When you translocate, a monster is sometimes pulled along with you.","display_strings[2].english":"You feel space start to knot itself around you.","display_strings[3].english":"You feel space untangle itself from you.","english_description":"Whenever you translocate, there is a chance that another monster is pulled\nalong to your new location. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"空气魔法包含直接用风造成伤害的法术，也包含轰鸣而强大的闪电咒法。\n其中也有一些实用法术，例如呼唤风来辅助移动，或用诅咒系法术阻止周围区域的大多数魔法。\n\n提升空气魔法技能会提升空气魔法法术的成功率和法术威力。许多法术属于多个魔法流派，\n对于这类法术，法术的成功率和法术威力由这些流派的技能平均值决定。","current_chinese_name":"空气魔法","titles[0].chinese":"阵风","titles[1].chinese":"和风术士","titles[2].chinese":"风暴召唤者","titles[3].chinese":"云中法师","titles[4].chinese":"天象师"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Air Magic provides spells to deal damage directly with the wind, as well as\nnoisy but powerful lightning Conjurations. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"咒法系魔法是关注战斗的魔法流派，\n旨在塑造出一团短暂存在的物质并将其推向敌人以造成伤害。\n提升咒法系技能通常会增加这类法术的伤害和命中率，有时也会增加其射程或影响范围。\n\n提升咒法系技能会提升咒法系法术的成功率和法术威力。许多法术属于多个魔法流派，\n对于这类法术，法术的成功率和法术威力由这些流派的技能平均值决定。","current_chinese_name":"咒法系","titles[0].chinese":"咒法师","titles[1].chinese":"毁灭者","titles[2].chinese":"毁灭者","titles[3].chinese":"破灭者","titles[4].chinese":"湮灭者"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Conjurations are battle oriented spells, which often work by conjuring up a\nchunk of short-lived matter and propelling it towards the victim to deal direct\ndamage. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"通过训练潜行，怪物在睡觉等不警觉的时候会更难注意到你，\n你从怪物的视野中消失后，它们也会更难追踪你。\n注意，更强大的怪物往往更加多疑、敏锐。\n\n潜行技能和你所装备武器对应的武器技能，\n共同决定攻击分心或无力反抗的生物时造成重创的几率和额外伤害量。","current_chinese_name":"潜行","titles[0].chinese":"潜行者","titles[1].chinese":"隐匿者","titles[2].chinese":"无形之人","titles[3].chinese":"无迹可寻","titles[4].chinese":"忍者"},"current_english":{"english_description":"By training Stealth, you can make it less likely that monsters will notice you\nif they are asleep or otherwise unalert, and increase your chances of monsters\nlosing track of you after you leave their vision. {"current_chinese":{"chinese_description":"召唤系魔法旨在从另一个现实位面召唤生物来暂时帮助你。\n提升召唤系技能会根据具体法术带来一系列效果，例如延长持续时间或召来更强大的盟友。\n需要注意的是，召唤生物不会留下尸体；击杀它们不会获得经验值，它们的装备也会随之消散。\n\n提升召唤系技能会提升召唤系法术的成功率和法术威力。许多法术属于多个魔法流派，\n对于这类法术，法术的成功率和法术威力由这些流派的技能平均值决定。","current_chinese_name":"召唤系","titles[0].chinese":"呼唤者","titles[1].chinese":"召唤师","titles[2].chinese":"召集者","titles[3].chinese":"缚界者","titles[4].chinese":"撕裂位面者"},"current_english":{"english_description":"Summonings deals with summoning creatures from another plane of reality to\ntemporarily aid you.
